study: DeCesare et al. 2017 — Retired Mentors for New Teachers program RCT (REL 2017-225, Aurora CO)
delivery_evidence: In-person mentoring: retired master educators provide one-on-one mentoring, with mentees meeting weekly one-on-one with their mentor and monthly in school-level groups over two years (monthly online records are dosage tracking, not delivery). (Overview p. ~1; program description)
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are NWEA MAP math and reading RIT scale scores, broad independent norm-referenced standardized achievement tests not tailored to the mentoring program. (Tables 2-3, pp. 7-8)
curriculum_evidence: Program is one-on-one mentoring to support new teachers' general practice (mentoring 'often focused on classroom management'); no new student curriculum or instructional-materials package is provided. (Program description; classroom-management focus noted in body)
outcome_timing_evidence: Primary (full-sample) records are the end-of-Year-2 (spring 2014/15) MAP impacts = end of the two-year intervention; the Year-1 waves are interim secondary records. (Tables 2-3; timepoint 'post Y2 (end of treatment)')
